exposure: Timing of cesarean section (elective or emergency)
Thickness of the lower uterine segment
outcome: Optimal healing of cesarean scar defect
cohort: 1015 women who underwent transvaginal repair of cesarean scar defect (CSD)
finding: A prediction model was developed to identify factors associated with optimal healing after transvaginal repair of cesarean scar defect, with a cutoff point of 16.5 indicating a higher likelihood of optimal healing.
